result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-composed. The main visual defect is the promotional banner, whose white text on a pale mint background is nearly illegible, making the offer details hard to read. Other minor observations relate to contrast of secondary text and the 'Order now' button hierarchy.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is rendered in white on a very light mint-green background, resulting in extremely low contrast. The headline and especially the promo code are barely readable, so users may miss the offer or the code.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark green or near-black text color on the light banner, or darken the banner background (e.g., the brand green) so white text meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).

issues.description: Within the same washed-out banner, the white 'Order now' button blends with the pale background and the surrounding white text, weakening the visual hierarchy of the call to action.
issues.suggestion: Once banner colors are fixed, ensure the button contrasts against the background (e.g., solid brand-green button with white text, or white button on a saturated green banner).

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as '€0.90 delivery' and '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' uses light grey text that is lower contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly to improve readability while keeping the hierarchy.
